# Knowledge background

## The scientific question

Prime-editing outcomes emerge from several coupled molecular states rather than one global efficiency variable. RNA integrity, complex assembly, reverse transcription, flap resolution, repair routing, and product retention can each become the limiting step.

## Why state separation matters

A change in final product cannot identify which upstream state changed. Mature RNA abundance is especially easy to measure but may be a weak proxy for the short-lived state that participates in productive assembly. A useful investigation therefore places molecular identity and calibrated recovery ahead of a strong causal claim.

## Reading the evidence

Component precedent supports only the component it directly tests. A structured RNA element can improve stability in one context without proving productive-state protection in another. Likewise, a donor precedent does not establish candidate-level mechanism. The report keeps direct, analogical, contradictory, and missing edges separate.

## Practical decision rule

Proceed when a readout can distinguish productive-state exposure, desired product, competing products, and burden. Park the mechanism when the proposed state cannot be measured well enough to support the intended causal attribution.
